name: Elegant Kinks
description: Elegant Kinks is a Brandon, FL loctician specialising in loc repair, loc extensions, and microlocs, with her own line of hair products, at two locations: 1005 W Busch Blvd Ste 106 and 2064 Badlands Dr Ste 12.

hero.title: Healthy locs, elegantly done.
hero.subtitle: Loc repair, loc extensions, and microlocs from a Brandon, FL loctician, with hair products made to keep your locs thriving. Two locations to serve you.

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder & Loctician
stylists.bio: The loctician behind Elegant Kinks, specialising in loc repair, loc extensions, and microlocs. She also creates hair products to keep your locs healthy between visits. Find her at 1005 W Busch Blvd Ste 106 or 2064 Badlands Dr Ste 12.

reviews.name: Keisha D.
reviews.text: She repaired locs I thought were too damaged to save. They look full and healthy again. True loc magic!

reviews.name: Amara O.
reviews.text: My microlocs came out so neat and even. She was patient through the whole install and explained everything.

reviews.name: Tasha W.
reviews.text: Got loc extensions for length and you can't tell where mine end and the extensions begin. Seamless!

reviews.name: Jordan B.
reviews.text: Her products keep my scalp and locs moisturized all week. Great retwist, great vibes, great products.

contact.address: 1005 W Busch Blvd Ste 106 & 2064 Badlands Dr Ste 12 (Brandon, FL area)
